Planning a Phu Quoc trip from India? 🇮🇳🇻🇳
This Phu Quoc Vietnam travel guide for Indians answers all the common questions about planning a Vietnam island trip from India.

In this video, you’ll discover:
Best places to visit in Phu Quoc, Vietnam
Top beaches, island hopping tours & cable car in Phu Qouc Vietnam
Phu Quoc itinerary – how many days are enough
Best time to visit Phu Quoc from India
Phu Quoc trip budget from India
Vietnam visa details for Indians
Night markets, food options & travel tips

We travelled to Phu Quoc and realised it is one of the best international beach destinations for Indian travellers, offering clean beaches, clear water, relaxed vibes, and easy connectivity from India.

We stayed at: https://www.booking.com/Share-q7p515
📍 Location: Phu Quoc, Vietnam
